decisions.decision: git.allow_default_branch_commits = true; commit directly on master
decisions.rationale: branching_strategy is "none" and every prior GSD commit lives on master. Re-homing onto a phase branch would have made that branch the GitHub default when 01-01 ran `gh repo create --push`, in a repo 01-05 later makes public.

decisions.decision: Share-URL contract = medium-8: 8 roughly-logarithmic lifetime buckets, gap rounded to nearest 1 pp, k-anonymity floor 25,000, TOP BUCKET OPEN-ENDED
decisions.rationale: fine-12 conceded it would not survive an adversarial read of an edge-worker log line — the exact threat the contract exists to survive. coarse-5 cost more share value than its extra headroom bought, and the worker-facing side is the traffic engine. The open-ended top bucket was a binding condition of the choice: a narrow high-end band is most identifying where fewest workers sit.

decisions.decision: Kept the two-document pnpm-lock.yaml; rejected 01-07's single-document rewrite
decisions.rationale: Document one is pnpm 12's packageManagerDependencies self-pin, not corruption. The rewrite drops it and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` then fails outright. CI ran frozen-lockfile on a clean runner against the two-document file at be02322 and passed — the 'breaks fresh installs' premise is disproved by a fresh install.

01-04's convention is that a country record is any .json without a leading underscore. Making the shared allowlist follow it means future shared files are excluded from the 27-country count automatically instead of breaking it.

decisions.decision: resolve() maps a paragraph citation key onto the article-keyed corpus, with an explicit DEFAULT_DIRECTIVE_LANGUAGE = 'eng' and a throw on an absent language
decisions.rationale: 01-03 re-keyed the corpus to <CELEX>#<article>@<lang3> with paragraphs nested. Serving English in place of a missing language would be a provenance failure.

next_action: Run /gsd-execute-phase 1 — it detects the six SUMMARY.md files and runs Wave 4 (01-05 governance gates) only. BEFORE dispatching any worktree executor, confirm `git rev-parse HEAD` equals `git rev-parse origin/master`; Claude Code forks worktrees from origin/HEAD, so an unpushed HEAD makes every worktree agent halt on a stale base.
context_notes: Phase 1 is 6/7 plans done, all merged to master, pushed, CI green on ba91509 (legal-data, cellar-reachability, nightly all success). Offline suite 276 passed / 0 failed; `pnpm rederive:vectors` reports 10/10 vectors agreeing with 45 recorded ambiguities. Working tree clean, no stray worktrees. Only 01-05 remains: it builds the governance that stops a wrong statute reaching a worker and drives a deliberately bad PR through each gate to prove it rejects. It is autonomous:false, so it WILL surface checkpoints. The single biggest lesson of this session is that Wave 2's four-way parallelism cost three serial integration fixes afterwards, because each plan built against a corpus shape the others were changing and the intra-wave overlap check only compares declared files_modified — it cannot see data-shape coupling. Wave 4 is a single plan, so that class of failure does not apply to what remains.
